occupation_title: JPDP Security Standard: Data Protection Officer Competency
text: Establishes statutory technical competencies for Data Protection Officers under the Personal Data Protection Standard 2015. Requires demonstrated capability to implement role-based access controls, conduct regular personal data inventory audits, enforce data retention schedules, and lead technical response containment for unauthorized data security breaches.
source: National Competency Framework: Personal Data Protection Department (JPDP)
source_doc: JPDP Personal Data Protection Standard 2015 Section 4

occupation_title: JPDP Data Transfer Standard: Cross-Border Cloud Compliance
text: Outlines regulatory compliance competencies for transferring personal data outside Malaysia under Section 129 of Act 709. Requires technical practitioners to conduct third-party jurisdiction assessments, enforce contractual binding corporate rules, and verify encryption standards for cross-border cloud transit.
source: National Competency Framework: Personal Data Protection Department (JPDP)
source_doc: JPDP Advisory on Cross-Border Data Transfers 2024

occupation_title: JPDP Mandatory Breach Notification Protocol Competency
text: Defines corporate operational standards for reporting personal data breach incidents to the Commissioner within 72 hours. source: National Competency Framework: Personal Data Protection Department (JPDP)
source_doc: JPDP Data Breach Notification Guidelines 2024

occupation_title: Bursa Malaysia Sustainability Guide: Carbon Accounting Competency
